transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I'm visiting today because I've been struggling a lot with staying focused and making careless mistakes with my work. On top of that, I constantly feel restless, like I just can't seem to sit still or relax. It's gotten really difficult to manage lately.
Can you tell me more about how often you experience difficulties with focus versus feeling restless and impulsive, and which one of these symptoms bothers you more or happens more frequently?

Honestly, both happen constantly and they are equally frustrating to deal with. On the focus side, I'm always making careless mistakes, missing details, and struggling to listen when people talk directly to me. At the same time, I feel this intense physical restlessness and keep blurting out answers before people can even finish their questions, which is just exhausting.
When did you first start noticing these symptoms of inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity, was it during childhood, adolescence, or did they develop more recently in adulthood?
I definitely remember having these issues during childhood, well before I turned 12. But this current, really difficult stretch has been going on continuously for about a year and two months now.
How have these symptoms of inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity affected your daily life, work, and relationships over the past year and two months?
I'm not quite sure how to describe the specific impact on my daily life, work, or relationships. But these behaviors have just been a constant, daily struggle for me for the past year and two months.
Can you give me some examples of how these symptoms affect your ability to organize tasks, set priorities, and follow through on responsibilities, such as at work or in your personal life?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest, as I haven't really thought about how it affects my organization or prioritization specifically. I just know that dealing with the day-to-day symptoms takes up most of my energy.

Have you experienced any other significant symptoms or issues, such as mood swings, anxiety, or substance use, that could be contributing to your current difficulties or might be related to your attention and hyperactivity symptoms?

No, I haven't really experienced any significant mood swings, anxiety, or substance use issues. My struggles are really just centered around the constant focus problems and that restless feeling I mentioned earlier.

To confirm, you're experiencing significant symptoms of both inattention, such as difficulty sustaining focus and making careless mistakes, and hyperactivity-impulsivity, such as feeling restless and blurting out answers, which have been present since childhood and are currently causing significant impairment in your daily life, is that correct?

Yes, that is exactly correct. I constantly struggle with making careless mistakes, feeling restless, and blurting out answers. These challenges have been with me since childhood, before I was 12, and they have been particularly difficult and persistent for the past year and two months.
